case_number: 2024 INSC 546; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 3059−3062 of 2024 (@ Special Leave Petition (Crl.) Nos. 8007−8010 of 2024)
summary: Power to grant interim stay of bail order under CrPC Section 439(2); stay improper without reasoned order; cancellation requires 'unjustified, illegal, or perverse' bail order; liberty under Article 21 curbed by stay; rare case justification needed; interim conditions preferred over stay; respondent's stay order set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act s.4
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; orders of stay dated 23 June 2023 and 22 May 2024 set aside; bail granted by Special Court on 17 June 2023 restored.
